title: Presentation Framework And Projektetage Migration
description: Build @framework/presentation/core (declarative render-independent presentation model) + @framework/presentation/renderer/react (React+reveal.js). Migrate mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage to eg-ice-25 intro (5 slides) with no direct react/reveal deps.
summary: Fixed the real auto-animate bug: participants were NOT morphing — they flew in from the deck's left edge (a constant translate(-168.148px,…)) as if reintroduced every slide. Root cause found by side-by-side live CDP probing of the running projektetage deck vs the temp/eg-ice-25 reference: -168.148px × presentationScale(1.48114) = 249px = exactly the slide's horizontal centering offset, so reveal.js measured the auto-animate `from` element at viewport x=0 (uncentered) instead of x=249. Why: reveal hides out-of-view-distance slides with the HTML `hidden` attribute, but AutoAnimate.run()'s un-hide guard only checks inline `fromSlide.style.display === 'none'`. A `hidden`-attribute slide therefore stays collapsed during getBoundingClientRect → rect (0,0,0,0) → the matched element starts at the deck origin and flies. eg-ice keeps its leaving slide laid out so its `from` rect is centered (verified eg-ice brand→title = translate(0px,-120px); mine was translate(-168.148px,…)). Fix (renderer/react): a focused `autoAnimateMatcher` (morphMatcher) that delegates to reveal's own getAutoAnimatePairs (keeping declarative data-id + text + media + code matching exactly like eg-ice) and attaches a `measure` function (measureMorphRect) to every pair. measureMorphRect walks the element's ancestor <section>s, temporarily removes any `hidden` attribute and forces display:block before getBoundingClientRect, then restores — guaranteeing centered, comparable from/to rects. Also pinned every (sub)slide horizontally with `.reveal .slides > section{,>section}{left:0;right:0}` in globals.css and set `.reveal .slides{text-align:center}` (was left) so an un-hidden slide centers during measurement, and added `.reveal{font-size:var(--r-main-font-size)}` + explicit heading-size rules to override the @ui/react Tailwind preflight reset. Verified live across the whole intro: brand→title name morphs translate(0px,73px); title→subtitle translate(0px,210.5px); subtitle→authors matches name(10)+title(11)+subtitle(12)+the three inner subtitle <h2> lines(13/14/15) and fades in the new authors block — all with 0 horizontal offset, exactly like eg-ice-25, no element flies. Tests green: renderer 5 (added inline vitest asserting morphMatcher injects a measure that preserves the slide's `hidden` attribute after measuring), core 6, projektetage 18.
